messages:
Priya: launching a config-only change to prod to try reduce tail latency. no model updates. summary: reduce batch_window_ms, tighten per-request timeout, and shift a small route weight to green for canary. change=cfg-2026-045. canary plan: 2% immediate, observe 15m, then 10% for 20m. pinned model-version=redwood-v2-2.

deploy-bot: Deploy initiated: cfg-2026-045 (config-only). Canary: 2% for 15m. Details: https://internal/deploys/cfg-2026-045

Luca: noted. I'll watch p50/p95/p99 + route-resolve error counts. Any rollback gates?

Priya: rollback if error-rate +0.3pp OR p95 > 120ms for 3 consecutive 1m windows. Also circuit-open rate on svc-egress >1% -> immediate pause.

Janelle: can you paste the exact config payload?

Priya: payload applied to canary: 
```
batch_window_ms: 4
max_tokens_per_batch: 80
route_timeout_ms: 150
route_weight: {green: 0.02}
```

deploy-bot: Config applied to canary. Scheduled hold at 2% for 15m.

Luca: ~4 minutes in: seeing small bump in queue length metric for routing-proxy (queue_len +40%), a few 504s from route-resolver. p95 nudged up ~18ms.

Janelle: 504s are coming from backend lookups timing out earlier than before. route_timeout_ms=150 might be too aggressive for some long-tail customers.

Priya: interesting. we tightened timeouts to avoid long waits, but if lookups occasionally take 200ms we will see errors. hold canary and don't ramp.

Luca: agree. recommend a targeted canary patch: increase route_timeout_ms -> 220 only for the canary to reduce spurious 504s while keeping overall tight timeout for majority.

Priya: do it. tag the patch cfg-2026-045a and note it's canary-only.

deploy-bot: PATCH applied to canary: route_timeout_ms=220. Change recorded: cfg-2026-045a. Observability: 10m stabilization suggested.

Luca: after patch, 504 spikes flattened, error-rate back to baseline. p95 dropped below original baseline. queue_len also returned to normal.

Janelle: adding to release notes: "config: reduced batch window and max_tokens_per_batch; tightened route timeout with canary hotpatch to 220ms after transient 504s; route weight shift to green 2%".

Priya: great catch. we'll keep this change in canary and re-run a perf job simulating heavy backend lookup latencies before broader rollout. scheduling a low-risk ramp tomorrow morning during change window.

Luca: I'll run a synthetic with varied backend latencies to validate route_timeout=220 is safe across tenants.

Priya: closing for now. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
